title: SPIES release an electrifying high-voltage rock soundtrack with “When Lightning Strikes”
htmlContent:
SPIES is back with a powerful new song that packs a punch. Their latest single, "When Lightning Strikes," is an exciting rock track full of energy and intensity. The driving guitar sounds and strong drum beats create a thrilling vibe that keeps your heart racing.

This track shows SPIES at their best, mixing catchy melodies with memorable hooks that make you want to increase the volume. The fast-paced rhythm matches the song's message about life's surprises, the excitement of being spontaneous, and the rush of taking chances. This song strikes with force like a lightning bolt and leaves a lasting impression.

https://open.spotify.com/track/6oKWVANmhe9Mpd7P0r2IiU?si=u-aDzlnSQN-AbwefiRwMtA

"When Lightning Strikes" is an energizing experience that makes you want to move. Whether you're on a road trip or caught in a storm, SPIES' new release is the perfect music for life's most thrilling moments.
